configurePresets.name: mac
configurePresets.description: The default build: every module, every test. `cmake -B build` is this preset by hand, and stays working without it.

configurePresets.name: ios
configurePresets.description: Cross-build of the Peregrine core for a phone (Pippin plan, P1). Tests, CLI tools and pyfvw are off automatically; the product is libpippin_core.a.

configurePresets.name: ios-sim
configurePresets.displayName: iOS simulator — pippin_core, and it RUNS
configurePresets.description: Same cross-build against the simulator SDK. This is the one that can be exercised: `xcrun simctl spawn booted build-ios-sim/port/apps/Pippin/pippin_link_check <pack>` opens the data pack and draws a frame of Kiawah. arm64 is the Apple-silicon simulator; an Intel mac wants x86_64.
